svg.title: Absolute and relative effects with a common denominator
svg.desc: In fictional independent groups of 100000, 200 versus 300 complete a referral within 90 days. Two standardized 1000-dot arrays show rates two and three per thousand. Difference one per thousand, 0.1 percentage points, relative increase 50 percent. The approximate Normal 95 percent confidence interval for the difference is 0.56 to 1.44 per thousand.
